page.overview:
Who is Cariandre Temalien?

Cariandre is plump, full-bosomed and 5'5 tall. She was good-looking, though not a beauty. She is described as wearing elaborately red-embroidered gray silk. She has dark eyes and hair which she wore cut short, exposing her ears.

She cultivated a cool, reserved air, such as she imagined a noblewoman to have. However, she also had a bad temper, and would snap at people she should not (such as sisters who stood above her) and say things better left unsaid.

Cariandre is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

She was born in Ghealdan in . Cariandre was the daughter of a shoemaker. She went to the White Tower in where she spent thirteen years as a novice and twelve as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in 972 NE.
